messages:
Maria Nguyen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a concise playbook update for the cache-eviction recurring pattern. Focus: triage commands, escalation path, and a short rollback decision tree. Who can take ownership?

Sam Patel: I can own runbook edits. Will add step-by-step triage and example commands. Target: Wed COB.

Alex Chen: Ill rewrite the escalation path and adjust paging thresholds to match current SLOs. Sync with Pager on Monday AM.

Tess SRE: Please include the exact commands we ran during the incident. Also we need a test checklist so we can validate in staging.

OpsBot: Incident summary (2026-03-22): KV cache thrash -> worker spinups -> cache evictions -> downstream latency spike. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/incidents/2026-03-22/cache-thrash

Sam Patel: Commands captured from the incident:
```
# inspect pods and eviction counts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-cache -o wide
# query eviction metric
curl -s 'http://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=cache_evictions_total'
# force cache rotate and restart one replica
kubectl -n inference exec -it kv-cache-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'mv /data/cache /data/cache.bak && kill 1'
```

Jordan Riley: I'll add an automated smoke test that simulates a TTL storm and validates eviction backoff behavior.

Maria Nguyen: Owners assigned: Sam (runbook triage), Alex (escalation/paging), Jordan (test plan), Tess (validation). Deadlines: Sam Wed COB, Alex Tue EOD, Jordan next Tue, Tess validate within 48h of PR merge. @Oncall please confirm no conflicts with existing dedicated runbooks.

Oncall Bot: @oncall Ack — no current conflicts. Recommend publishing to staging canary first. :eyes:

Alex Chen: Adding a "when to rollback" bullet: reference model routing fallback, decrease batch sizes, and switch to cache-bypass route if available.

Sam Patel: Opened PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1287 — includes triage steps, commands, and checklist. Please review and tag with `postmortem-cache-eviction`.

Tess SRE: Reviewing now. Two suggestions: add `kubectl describe pod` to triage and a PromQL for 'kv_cache_inflight' so SREs can detect pressure before evictions.

Maria Nguyen: Excellent. I'll add these action items and due dates to the postmortem tracker and mark owners. Schedule a tabletop to exercise the new playbook.

Jordan Riley: I'll book a 45m tabletop for Thu 09:30 PT and include a short synthetic test run.

Sam Patel: Thanks all — will update PR with Tess's notes. Closing loop once staging test passes. :raised_hands:
